description: This Java class 'SupportUtil' provides utility methods for styling and setting text with URLs in Android TextView components, including methods for making text bold and embedding clickable links.

classes.name: SupportUtil
classes.description: A utility class for styling text and embedding URLs in Android TextView components.

methods.name: strong
methods.description: Returns a SpannableString with the input text styled in bold.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns a SpannableString with the input text linked to the specified URL target.

methods.name: setTextWithURL
methods.description: Sets the TextView's text with a URL span, either by resource IDs or by direct string, and enables link clicking.
